recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-14234 unless a future THO-specific issue identifies a problem in the external SNOMED CT guidance page.
issue_request: FHIR-14234 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 vocabulary change request to replace broken SNOMED CT URI Specification links from http://snomed.org/uristandard.pdf with a non-PDF SNOMED URI; the issue description requested http://snomed.org/uristandard and a Jira comment suggested http://snomed.org/uri.
initial_application: Commit aeb50b0a3e fixed one summary-table typo before the Jira issue, and the Jira-tagged commit 824a1ffe9f (svn revision 13446, GF#14234) changed the remaining implicit value set and implicit concept map SNOMED CT URI Specification links in source/snomedct.html from uristandard.pdf to http://snomed.org/uri.
additional_context: Commit 81e5862f20 for FHIR-35933 later removed source/snomedct.html from core and updated the Code Systems hierarchy. Current core source points from source/terminologies-systems.html to THO's SNOMED CT guidance and keeps only source/snomedct-usage.html as the local usage report under source/hierarchy.xml.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit is needed because the broken PDF link is absent from current source, the old local page was removed from the current build hierarchy, and reintroducing a local SNOMED URI Specification link would be redundant.

related_jiras.note: Removed the old local SNOMED CT guidance page from core and left core pointing to THO for detailed SNOMED CT guidance.
